description: In the diff viewer, Ctrl+F opens Monaco's find widget, typing in it works, and Escape closes the find widget, not the viewer. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a git repository with commits. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open the Diffs tool: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). 3. The overlay ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 4. Click the first ".diff-rethink-message-files .diff-tree-code-row" in the overlay; ".diff-rethink-file-name" should be visible. 5. Wait until the overlay's ".diff-viewer-editor" is visible and contains at least one ".monaco-editor" element. 6. The editor container must contain exactly 0 ".find-widget.visible" elements. 7. Without clicking or focusing anything, press "f" with the Control modifier. 8. ".diff-viewer-editor .find-widget.visible" should become visible. 9. Type "test.file" key by key (a real keystroke for each character, including the ".", which would otherwise trigger "next change" navigation). 10. The find widget's text box with accessible name "Find" (its textarea or input with aria-label "Find") should have a value containing "test.file". 11. The overlay should still be visible. 12. Press Escape. 13. There should be exactly 0 ".find-widget.visible" elements in the editor container. 14. The overlay should still be visible. 15. Press Escape again. 16. There should be exactly 0 ".diff-viewer-overlay" elements.
